snippet.title: BECROWNED | Horror Game Awards 2025 WORLD PREMIERE
snippet.description:
Richard Torrance is a man who will do anything to get what he wants. Rational and cold-blooded, he will strive to shape the world to his desires... except, this striving sees his existence juxtaposed against a surreal, ruined ancient kingdom. Sinners, heretics, and even gods — this merciless, twisted world is a prison for those who truly deserve punishment. In this place, there are no innocents, no kindness, and no mercy. Will you prove this as truth, or will you challenge it? ---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
